subject: Clearbridge RCA: concise timeline, root cause, and customer action commitments
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearbridge.com>, Nadia Patel <nadia.patel@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Clearbridge RCA: concise timeline, root cause, and customer action commitments

Tom / Nadia —

Thank you again for your patience while our team completed the investigation into the service degradation on 2026-08-14 that affected a subset of API requests to your dedicated pool. Attached is a short customer-facing RCA and the evidence bundle we referenced during the call. I wanted to surface the critical elements here and call out the specific actions we will take and what we need from Clearbridge.

Executive summary (tl;dr):
- Impact: 11:20–11:46 UTC on 2026-08-14, increased 5xx rate and token-generation timeouts for ~3% of requests routed to your pool; no data exfiltration detected.
- Root cause: regression in our retry/backoff gate combined with a KV-cache eviction storm triggered by a model rollout that temporarily increased peak memory and caused rare eviction-induced latency spikes.
- Customer-facing actions we commit to: scheduling a controlled re-roll with a telemetry guard, increased KV-cache headroom for your dedicated pool, one week of elevated monitoring and daily status updates, and a customer evidence bundle.

What we did (short):
- Collected service and kernel-level traces, KV-cache metrics, and request logs (evidence_kv_metrics.csv attached).
- Reproduced the eviction pattern in a synthetic harness and confirmed the interaction with the backoff logic.
- Deployed a rollback of the rollout config within 40 minutes on 8/14 which restored baseline.

Planned next steps (actions & owners):
1) Immediate control: increase cache headroom for your dedicated pool to 25% (Marcus Lin, completed 8/16 07:30 UTC).
2) Rollout safety: we will add a secondary telemetry guard to detect eviction-rate anomalies and pause rollouts automatically (Marissa Cole, ETA 2026-08-20).
3) Nightly verification: one week of daily verification reports and morning summaries (Irene Choi, daily 08:00 UTC, starting 2026-08-17).
4) Postmortem package: final RCA PDF and raw evidence uploaded to shared Drive (attached rca_clearbridge_v1.pdf; link below).

What we need from you:
- Please confirm a 2-hour window next week (preferred 2026-08-19 10:00–12:00 UTC) for a joint verification run to validate the cache-change under your observed traffic patterns.
- If you have any internal SRE scripts that exercise large-batch replay, please flag them so we can ensure safety during the verification window.

Attachments: rca_clearbridge_v1.pdf (summary + timeline), evidence_kv_metrics.csv (sampled counters), timeline_events.log (truncated).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-rca-clearbridge
Jira: JIRA-INC-1234

We appreciate the partnership and will keep updates concise and action-oriented.

—
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearbridge.com>, Nadia Patel <nadia.patel@clearbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clearbridge RCA: concise timeline, root cause, and customer action commitments

Thanks Irene — adding a short technical note for clarity so Clearbridge has actionable verification steps.

Technical addendum (Marissa):
- Key metric: KV-cache eviction-rate (% evictions per million ops). During the event we observed a sustained spike from baseline ~20 -> 1,200 evictions/million ops for a 3-minute window which cascaded into longer tail latencies when combined with the retry gate.
- How we will measure: we will expose a temporary metric group clearbridge.kv.eviction_rate and a derived alert if 1-minute rolling > 300 evictions/million.
- Safe-mode behavior: when the derived alert fires during a rollout, the rollout controller will reduce parallelism to 1 and pause any new model variant traffic for 10 minutes while automatically scaling cache headroom by +15%.

Planned test steps for joint verification run (short):
1) Redwood will enable the derived metric and temporary alert in your telemetry namespace.
2) Clearbridge runs a 30-minute replay at 2x normal peak traffic for a staged subset; Redwood will watch eviction_rate and pause if threshold exceeded.
3) Post-run, both parties compare aggregated metrics for latency tails and eviction rate.

Marcus and I have scheduled the rollout safety patch for 2026-08-20. Marcus — confirming you completed the cache headroom change? Please confirm time and configuration details so I can record them in the final RCA.

—Marissa
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clearbridge RCA: concise timeline, root cause, and customer action commitments

Confirmed — cache headroom increased for Clearbridge dedicated pool (pool-id cb-prod-4) to +25% as of 2026-08-16T07:30:00Z. Change summary:
- Parameter: KV_CACHE_HEADROOM_PERCENT = 25 (was 10)
- Validation: ran a 15-minute synthetic workload that exercised prefix-heavy requests; observed no eviction spikes and 95th latency reduced by ~40ms.
- Evidence files uploaded to Drive: evidence_kv_metrics.csv and timeline_events.log.

Irene/Marissa — I'll be on the verification call if scheduled.

—Marcus
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nadia Patel <nadia.patel@clearbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearbridge RCA: concise timeline, root cause, and customer action commitments

Irene / Marissa / Marcus —

Appreciate the clear summary and the evidence package. We reviewed the PDF and the metrics dump this morning. A few quick items from our side:
- We accept the proposed verification window on 2026-08-19 10:00–12:00 UTC. Please share an invite and runbook.
- We will flag two internal replay jobs that could interact with cache pressure and will share the script names by EOD 8/17.
- For the record, we'd like the rollback-safe guard to include an automated customer notification hook (email + webhook) before rollback pauses so our on-call can triage in parallel; can you add that to the rollout safety patch?

If you can include the invite and the verification runbook by 08:00 UTC on 8/18 that will give our SREs time to align.

Thanks —
Tom
Head of Platform Operations
Clearbridge Systems
